common.description: Finite input, scalar-material, Schur-complement and exponent identities shared by the reductions.
common.boundary: The default build imports Algebra, Complexity and Interfaces; it is not an end-to-end realization proof.

continuum.description: Continuum analytic components and the finite parameter, representation and decoder constructions imported by the audit root.
continuum.boundary: The verifier inventories the imported component theorems and replays their dependencies; it does not certify the complete continuum reduction or every continuum source.

discrete.description: Navigation roots for the Yee stencil and selected discrete platform and instance components.
discrete.boundary: These are selected component entry points, not a complete discrete audit. The selected-platform existence theorem has explicit PointClusterComplementGap, PointOtherSectorExclusion and PointRealEdgeExclusion hypotheses.
